units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:5">Sabb. VIII, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 80b:6">80ᵇ</cite>) <he>כדי לזבל כ׳</he> as much manure as is required for one leek plant. Y. ib. VII, 9ᵈ bot. <he>כדי ליטע כרישה</he> as much space as is required for planting one leek.
<cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 1:5">Makhsh. I, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Makhshirin 1:5">Tosef. ib. I, 5</cite>.—Pl. <he>כָּרֵישִׁים</he>, <he>כָּרֵישִׁין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 1:2">Kil. I, 2</cite> <he>כ׳ וכְרֵישֵׁי שדה וכ׳</he> (garden) leek and field-leek … are not heterogeneous, v. <cite ref="K00674"><he>כִּלְאַיִם</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 15:14">Tosef. Sabb. XV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 16:14">XVI</cite>), 14 <he>גוזזין לו כ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>כרשינן</he>) we may cut leek for him (on the Sabbath, as a remedy for a serpent’s bite).

<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 6:9">Ned. VI, 9</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Nedarim 3:6">Tosef. ib. III, 6</cite>; Y. ib. VI, 39ᵈ bot., v. <cite ref="S01753"><he>קִפְלוֹט</he></cite>; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="K01287"><he>כָּרָתֵי</he></cite>.
